description:
GenServer wrapping a ts_elixir Tailscale.Tcp.Listener handle.

Manages Tailscale device lifecycle + listener.

State:
  - dev: Tailscale.t() (device handle from Tailscale.connect)
  - listener: Tailscale.Tcp.Listener.t()
  - local_addr: {ip, port}

Startup flow:
  1. Tailscale.connect(keys_file, opts) → dev handle
  2. Tailscale.Tcp.listen(dev, addr, port) → listener handle
  3. Tailscale.Tcp.Listener.local_addr(listener) → {ip, port}

Public API:
  - accept(listener_pid) → {:ok, socket_pid} | {:error, reason}
    Calls Tailscale.Tcp.Listener.accept(listener) (blocking, on dirty scheduler)
    Spawns a GenTailscale.Socket for the accepted stream
    Returns the socket pid
  - accept(listener_pid, timeout) → same with timeout
  - close(listener_pid) → :ok
  - sockname(listener_pid) → {:ok, {ip, port}}

Config options (passed through from listen/2):
  - hostname, authkey, dir, control_url, ephemeral — Tailscale device config
  - keys_file — path to ts_elixir keys file
  - Standard socket opts passed through to spawned sockets
title: Implement GenTailscale.Listener GenServer
